_meta.name: L2 自由 prompt 预设库
_meta.note: 所有 prompt 均为英文（ACE-Step 的 caption 为英文）。脚本会自动追加 'instrumental only, no vocals, background music'，预设里无需重复。
_meta.durations: 短视频建议 20~45s；公众号/长视频建议 60~120s

guoxue_ink.label: 国学 · 水墨古韵
guoxue_ink.scene: 国学经典短视频 / 诗词诵读 / 水墨画面
guoxue_ink.prompt: traditional Chinese instrumental, guqin and guzheng, sparse bamboo flute dizi, deep temple ambience, ink-wash painting mood, contemplative and serene

guoxue_temple.label: 国学 · 禅寺晨钟
guoxue_temple.scene: 道家/佛家文化 / 修行感悟 / 晨课
guoxue_temple.prompt: zen meditation instrumental, distant temple bell, low singing bowl, gentle wind chime, minimal guqin pluck, spacious and sacred atmosphere

guoxue_epic_history.label: 国学 · 史书大气
guoxue_epic_history.scene: 历史人物 / 王朝兴衰 / 家国情怀
guoxue_epic_history.prompt: epic Chinese historical orchestral, taiko drums and erhu, sweeping strings, french horn swells, ancient battlefield grandeur, solemn and powerful

emotion_healing.label: 情感 · 温柔治愈
emotion_healing.scene: 女性成长 / 自我和解 / 温暖叙事
emotion_healing.prompt: warm healing instrumental, soft felt piano, airy string pad, gentle music box accents, morning sunlight feeling, comforting and hopeful

emotion_release.label: 情感 · 释怀离别
emotion_release.scene: 告别 / 放下 / 成长代价
emotion_release.prompt: melancholic instrumental, slow solo piano with soft cello, sparse and breathy, rain at dusk mood, bittersweet and reflective

emotion_empower.label: 情感 · 觉醒力量
emotion_empower.scene: 自我价值 / 逆袭 / 女性力量
emotion_empower.prompt: uplifting cinematic instrumental, building piano arpeggios, warm strings crescendo, light percussion entering, rising and empowering, triumphant but tender

silver_nostalgia.label: 银发 · 岁月怀旧
silver_nostalgia.scene: 人生感悟 / 子女亲情 / 旧时光
silver_nostalgia.prompt: nostalgic instrumental, old upright piano, warm accordion, subtle vinyl warmth, slow waltz feel, reminiscent and gentle like old family photographs

silver_morning.label: 银发 · 晨间清朗
silver_morning.scene: 晨练 / 慢生活 / 日常烟火
silver_morning.prompt: cheerful acoustic instrumental, fingerpicked guitar, light whistling melody, soft shaker percussion, sunny morning market ambience, relaxed and content

daily_vlog.label: 日常 · 慢生活 vlog
daily_vlog.scene: 生活记录 / 咖啡 / 书房 / 手作
daily_vlog.prompt: lo-fi chill instrumental, mellow electric piano, soft brushed drums, vinyl crackle, rainy afternoon cafe mood, laid-back and cozy

tension_open.label: 开场 · 悬念钩子
tension_open.scene: 前3秒抓人 / 悬念 / 盘点开头
tension_open.prompt: tense cinematic intro, pulsing low synth bass, ticking percussive texture, dissonant string swell, suspenseful build-up, mysterious and gripping

dark_mystery.label: 暗色 · 压抑悬疑
dark_mystery.scene: 警示 / 深度思考 / 人性议题
dark_mystery.prompt: dark ambient instrumental, low drone, dissonant minor strings, distant metal resonance, sparse heartbeat percussion, oppressive and introspective

ending_elevate.label: 尾声 · 升华留白
ending_elevate.scene: 结尾升华 / 金句收束 / 片尾
ending_elevate.prompt: serene closing instrumental, sustained piano chord fading, airy choir pad, gentle harp glissando, open and reflective, fading into silence

broll_nature.label: 空镜 · 山水自然
broll_nature.scene: 风景空镜 / 四季 / 山川云海
broll_nature.prompt: pastoral instrumental, wooden flute and zither, flowing guzheng arpeggios like water, birdsong hint, vast mountain and mist imagery, tranquil and expansive

arabic_exotic.label: 异域 · 大漠丝路
arabic_exotic.scene: 丝绸之路 / 异域文化 / 神秘叙事
arabic_exotic.prompt: middle eastern instrumental, oud and darbuka, desert caravan rhythm, exotic maqam scale, mysterious and ancient, trading route atmosphere
